resolved_findings.resolution: Runtime proof is bound to issuing credential, workspace, agent and runtime; execution checks require native authentication and proof.
Current approved proposals prevent metadata edits that change execution intent.
Explicit holds prevent Ready, Requeue and Claim; recovery requires external reconciliation and reviewed replacement work.
An atomic expired tombstone excludes commit before R2 deletion; late uploads remain orphans.
Human message-review authority is explicit and thread participants cannot expand through replies.
Decisions bind immutable committed JSON input artifact identity and verified digest.
CSRF/origin and durable outbox checks apply from the first release exposing those operations.
Assets outside the current closed profile schema are explicitly deferred.
No unavailable renewal command is implied; recovery is triage and authorized cancellation/replacement.
Machine output remains the native envelope; context is separate and one-time enrollment secrets are securely captured then redacted.
The fixture uses the actual task-command envelope and its mapping is checked against the operation response schema.

additional_reviewed_rules: Lease expiry defaults to an uncertainty hold unless trusted replay-safe policy was established before execution and recorded at claim/audit; stale runtimes cannot mutate expired attempts.
Kanban personalization wording follows the closed profile schema; arbitrary navigation/column overrides are deferred.
limitations: This is a contract review, not runtime security certification.
No product execution, deployment or restoration was performed.
External link availability and rendered diagrams are not covered by the validator.
